status: public authored development pilot; no held-out or dollar-savings claim

controls.model: qwen3.8-27b / Unsloth UD-IQ3_S on local llama.cpp
controls.cache: Restart existing local engine only while idle before each run, preserving same container configuration; fresh native session per run; allow within-run cache reuse. Preserve engine/gateway receipts and contamination/unknowns.
controls.execution: Sequential; no advisors, configured provider retries or fallback calls. Retain all failures; no solution repair or altered gold between arms.

acceptance: Same strict standalone failing-to-passing test-loop, native terminal and scope gates; six visible plus seven predeclared gold checks. A run must actually compact to qualify as a compaction stress trial.
metrics: Native elapsed time, artifact acceptance, request and compaction counts, forwarded estimates, selector CPU/wall, client-reported usage/Claude TTFT, engine weighted decode TPS. Codex true TTFT unavailable. No inferred TTFT from native LiteLLM first-chunk fallback.
interpretation: Four single descriptive trials; paths may diverge. No general task-success, statistical speedup or whole-task bill claim.
